source_basis.work: 中州派紫微斗数深造讲义（下册）

major_findings: TP04 closes the remaining Tianliang section and the full Qisha and Pojun sections of Property Palace; the next printed heading is 福德宫, so P10 source coverage ends at TP04-358.

The tail preserves inherited/property acquisition, residence and work-environment movement, service-institution pressure, fengshui sensitivity and bounded event candidates as separate projection surfaces.
TP04-305 restores the source's two benefic Tianliang-Tiantong property alternatives instead of keeping only out-of-region acquisition.
TP04-323, TP04-341 and TP04-350 retain source-explicit ordered relations as PATH_DEPENDENT_GATE without fixed lags, probabilities or value magnitudes.
TP04-327/333/357 narrow damaged `倾效`/`降黩` wording rather than turning it into precise collapse/demotion claims.
TP04-328 removes an unsupported blood-related gloss; the source only supports household sadness/tears in that clause.
TP04-349 and TP04-352 preserve `天铖` / `财阴夹` source glyphs rather than silently normalizing them.
TP04-330 preserves `中晚年始能置产` literally without numericization.
